name: Geeks vs Superheroes
source:
This is a semi-open-world game where you play two superhero geeks (Patrick and Kouji) that will manage to get their hands on a brainwashing device allowing them to take control of anybody including superheroes. 

[From [url=https://satyroom.itch.io/geeks-vs-superhero-episode-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款半开放世界的游戏，你扮演两个超级英雄极客（帕特里克和晃司），他们将设法获得洗脑装置，使他们能够控制包括超级英雄在内的任何人。

[来自[url=https://satyroom.itch.io/geeks-vs-superhero-episode-1]Itch.io[/url]]
